data.name: Mandeep
data.gender_notes: Mandeep is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Sanskrit words ‘manda’ (moon) and ‘deep’ (deep). This name symbolizes a person who is deeply connected to the divine moon. The name Mandeep carries the meaning “Moon-deep” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Mandeep usually hope their child will grow to embody moon-deep and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that evokes the divine presence of the moon, symbolizing peace, tranquility, and nourishment.
data.etymology: Mandeep belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Moon-deep.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Mandeep total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.
